sloka: तत्र कृष्ण अजिन धरम् जटा वल्कल धारिणम् ।ददर्श नियत आहारम् मारीचम् नाम राक्षसम् ॥३-३५-३८॥
transliteration: tatra kṛṣṇa ajina dharam jaṭā valkala dhāriṇam ।dadarśa niyata āhāram mārīcam nāma rākṣasam ॥3-35-38॥

translations.english: There he saw a demon Maricha, by name, clad in dark deerskin and bark ,with matted hair and living on restricted food.
